## Sallie Mae Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


10/22/2026


Download this Press Release PDF Format (opens in new window)


[SLM 2026 Q3 Earnings Release Supplement PDF](https://s25.q4cdn.com/936990699/files/doc_news/2026/SLM-Corp_Q3-2026-Earnings-Release-Supplement-v3.pdf)


NEWARK, Del.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Sallie Mae (Nasdaq: SLM), formally SLM Corporation, today released third quarter 2026 financial results. Complete financial results and related materials are available at[www.SallieMae.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.SallieMae.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54627424&newsitemid=20261022256833&lan=en-US&anchor=www.SallieMae.com%2Finvestors&index=1&md5=06aac5281248fda0d1f1c7d1f56b45d9) . The materials will also be available on the Securities and Exchange Commission’s website at[www.sec.gov](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov&esheet=54627424&newsitemid=20261022256833&lan=en-US&anchor=www.sec.gov&index=2&md5=cd5067048286c90570bad4974618c48b) .


Sallie Mae will host an earnings conference call today, Oct. 22, 2026, at 5:30 p.m. ET. Executives will be on hand to discuss various highlights of the quarter and to answer questions related to Sallie Mae’s performance. A live audio webcast of the conference call and presentation slides may be accessed at[www.SallieMae.com/investors](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.SallieMae.com%2Finvestors&esheet=54627424&newsitemid=20261022256833&lan=en-US&anchor=www.SallieMae.com%2Finvestors&index=3&md5=8d81cd109f0375cd11a71318b30d4373) and the[hosting website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevent.on24.com%2Fwcc%2Fr%2F5523847%2F91262F77DA65CD23ECA49F4AB6D8DA70&esheet=54627424&newsitemid=20261022256833&lan=en-US&anchor=hosting+website&index=4&md5=b36317d2098169f1166ae4650bab46aa) .


A replay of the webcast will be available via the company’s investor website approximately two hours after the call’s conclusion.


**Sallie Mae** (Nasdaq: SLM) believes education and life-long learning, in all forms, help people achieve great things. As the leader in private student lending, we provide financing and know-how to support access to college and offer products and resources to help customers make new goals and experiences, beyond college, happen. Learn more at SallieMae.com. Commonly known as Sallie Mae, SLM Corporation and its subsidiaries are not sponsored by or agencies of the United States of America.
